title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: Reel > Apogee Mini ME 24/96> Apogee Mini DAC(monitoring)>Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44)>CD>EAC>Minor Repairs on the GEMS Edit Station>Trac'ed Cdwave Flac'ed level 8 TLH

ai_review.summary: Great 1973 show captured on a cleaned‑up SBD, but the Dolby‑style processing dulls the high end for some listeners.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as a killer show from May 13 1973, with reviewers noting the overall excitement of the set. The source is a soundboard tape that has been heavily cleaned up; while one listener appreciates the cleanup, another complains that the Dolby processing strips away high‑frequency detail, making the recording feel flat. Overall the music shines despite mixed opinions on the sonic treatment.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give moderate to good scores (3 and 4 stars). The show is described as great, but recording quality receives both praise and criticism, leading to a balanced rating around the mid‑range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hiss removed, but Dolby‑style processing reduces high end and makes the sound feel overly processed; some listeners find it nicely cleaned up despite this.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers comment that the show is a "killer" performance overall, though no specific set‑list details are given.
